hero.title: Two applications, one focus: fuel distribution
hero.subtitle: Zylo Office doesn't try to be a generic ERP with dozens of half-useful modules. We build two deep applications, each purpose-built for one part of the fuel distribution business in Africa: service stations (Zylo Liquid) and tanker truck fleets (Zylo Tanker).

zyloLiquid.title: Zylo Liquid
zyloLiquid.description: Day-to-day operation of a service station network: real-time tank monitoring, level and leak alerts, cash management and reconciliation, automatically detected deliveries, network pricing, and a shop for non-fuel products.

tanks.title: Tanks and gauges
tanks.description: Level, volume and status of every tank at every station, with measurement history and threshold tracking.

alerts.title: Level and leak alerts
alerts.description: Network alert center (low/high level, water presence, offline sensor or station) and a log of static leak tests.

cash.title: Cash and reconciliation
cash.description: Daily cash summary by currency, from the network down to the tank, plus reconciliation between declared sales and telemetric stock.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.description: Register of fuel deliveries automatically detected from tank level jumps.

pricing.title: Price configuration
pricing.description: Per-fuel, per-station price grid with change history and bulk updates across the network.

shop.title: Product shop
shop.description: Catalog and counter sales for a station's non-fuel products, with sales history.

zyloTanker.title: Zylo Tanker
zyloTanker.description: Tracking a fleet of tanker trucks: live supervision, fuel consumption, onboard pump management, tanks and gauges, and regulatory documentation with its deadlines.

supervision.title: Fleet supervision
supervision.description: Position and status of every vehicle on a map, with fleet indicators and ongoing alarms.

consumption.title: Fuel consumption
consumption.description: Consumption tracking per vehicle and per trip, with an estimated cost.

pumps.title: Pump management
pumps.description: Flow rate, temperature and status of each vehicle's onboard pumps.

tanks.title: Onboard tanks
tanks.description: Level and temperature gauges for each vehicle's tanks, with alert thresholds.

documents.title: Documentation and certificates
documents.description: Plans, manuals and certificates for each vehicle, with upcoming deadline tracking.

closingCta.title: Let's talk about your needs
closingCta.subtitle: Whether you run a station network, a tanker truck fleet, or both, let's talk about your organization and how Zylo Office can fit it.
